description: He wears a long muted teal crossed-front coat with gold woven floral and geometric borders, over a brown patterned underlayer visible at the collar and sleeves. The outer short sleeves sit above fitted patterned long sleeves. Narrow pale fur-like trim edges the cuffs and lower hem. A broad dark leather belt with round metal ornaments secures the waist; a decorated hanging sash and tassels fall down one side. Brown patterned trousers are visible below the coat, ending in tall dark brown leather boots. There is no armor, weapon or headgear.
